notes.title: Development Update: Meet the Crew
notes.content:
Boobies, boobies, none of ’em small, but who’s got the jiggliest of them all?

An update on [b]Serpentine Shadows[/b] development.


[h3]Under the Hood[/h3]

Mid-April, we’re aiming to kick off internal testing of the alpha version of [b]Serpentine Shadows[/b] — a game build you can run from start and finish, although mostly with visual placeholders. This version isn’t meant for any kind of distribution — it’s for us to hunt down bugs, test game logic, and verify that gameplay flow actually works the way we want to.

We were hoping to hit this stage in March, but, well… life happened and our optimism got reality-checked. We’re building [b]Serpentine Shadows[/b] in Unity — not the most complex engine out there, but it’s still new to us, and has a tendency to throw surprises our way.

If alpha testing confirms that the game can be completed without major issues — with all the endings unlocking properly — the next step is to pump out the missing visual assets and prepare a playable demo ASAP.


[h3]Graphics[/h3]

Most of the dialogue animations are finished. The main characters each have three to four animation loops that alternate to create a subtle illusion of motion. Below you’ll find a few sample loops. This is our typical way of presenting characters during dialogue — similar to our previous games.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/417141f52896a6d7317c83f97b0ffaeff008a61c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/417141f52896a6d7317c83f97b0ffaeff008a61c.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/dbf50854a6dbed69f74e83756cba4d58cc516090.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/dbf50854a6dbed69f74e83756cba4d58cc516090.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/e36d645910a60c00a5650e6874ddc8024d92b127.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/e36d645910a60c00a5650e6874ddc8024d92b127.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/cfc211b385c4e9a050e8fdc0273452355c512cb0.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/cfc211b385c4e9a050e8fdc0273452355c512cb0.gif[/img][/url]


Dialogue animations are reserved for main characters only. Minor NPCs will use static renders — the kind you’ve probably seen in most NV-style games. To make up for the lack of animation, minor NPCs will often change poses during conversations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/87e42fe51b0ede2beac7cac3b0e0ac368c99d9a7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/f7083030b5acdab932d799028c2eb2d142c0e2d2.jpg[/img]


[b]Serpentine Shadows[/b] is our first proper dive into the VN genre. Like most visual novels, it offers limited interaction options — but that doesn’t mean none at all. Below you can see one of the “hubs” inside the Black Pearl pirates’ base. This is where you’ll conduct most of your investigation into the mysterious murders and disappearances plaguing the crew (of horny pirates, obviously — as you can probably tell from the preview).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/7d93448898a14a3c0fe4613b8849ceb5d04edb29.jpg[/img]


While work on sex and dialogue animations has begun only recently, a good chunk of static illustrations is already done. Some have already gone through post-production, others are still in the queue.


Jackie is a big fan of chemsex. If you play your cards right, you’ll get to find out exactly what she brings to the table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/91e166a73d222101d08be97e84f75cdb6f27c017.jpg[/img]


Of all the Black Pearl crew, Piglet’s probably the most “wholesome” — wouldn’t hurt a fly… Unless it gives her a chance to test some new gear.

Here you can see her prepping some slaves for portable experimental “electric shepherd” gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/dfb41d5430a789aec3e0a4bd51fa08c841f0eb50.jpg[/img]


And here’s one of the weirder places on the island (not the weirdest though!). No spoilers — it shows up later in the story and is tied to some unexpected twists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/0adb52f3d780c805049daaeef45addccec27fb77.jpg[/img]


As for a release date — we can’t give you one just yet. Our current priority is to get a functioning alpha running this month, identify and squash any gameplay issues, and get that playable demo out to you all as soon as humanly possible.

notes.title: Development Update: Introducing Honeytraps
notes.content:
Black Pearl gathered around herself a diverse group of characters. In the upcoming updates, we’ll introduce you to some of the groups and coteries that form Pearl's crew.

If the years filled with violence and bloodshed have taught the Black Pearl anything, it is surely this: most battles can be won before they even begin...
Pirate Queen's crew consists mainly of women and futanari. men – and only those who have proven their usefulness and loyalty – are just a handful among them. Yet, the crew of the Black Pearl has little trouble taking over even the best-armed ships or those manned by the most elite soldiers. Commanded by the Black Pearl pirate corvette, the Rabid Bitch seems to appear out of nowhere, selecting as its targets only ships carrying the most valuable cargo, then vanishing like a ghost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/1801080349e23fd38d45b0308a571a75d4e1992a.jpg[/img]

The secret to these seemingly supernatural abilities lies in the Honey Traps – members of the crew, mostly attractive women and delicate ladyboys scattered across various ports. They intoxicate, seduce, and sleep with crew members of other ships, extracting information about cargo and planned routes. If a particularly well-guarded ship catches their interest, they sneak aboard through bribery or blackmail and, when the opportunity arises, lace the food with powerful drugs...


[h3]Jackie Swallow[/h3]
Age: 26

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/4fb23b410fcbd4048b19da8d68ceb4594bb5298c.jpg[/img]
Protégé of the Pearl and one of the main characters in the game. She abuses alcohol to numb the guilt she feels about her work. During the brief times she spends at the pirate base, rather than in port taverns (she’s the most effective of all the Honey Traps), she throws herself recklessly into chemsex with other crew members. Compulsive sex and her vulgar demeanor are merely her clumsy way of numbing the pain tearing at her heart. In rare moments of sobriety, she can be surprisingly refined and girlish, quoting works of forgotten poets and longing for true love... During the game, you’ll have the chance to uncover secrets from her past, and to discover the truth about her relationship with the Black Pearl...


[h3]Chouka[/h3]
Age: 34 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/ad2cbfb6cf5629b845adc42d8bfda6469bcddfb1.jpg[/img]
Master of the sword and a bondage enthusiast. When her ethereal, sensual methods – from tea ceremonies to seductive shamisen playing to sensual massages in opium-laden air – fail, she gains the necessary information in other ways. There’s no man in the world whose tongue wouldn’t loosen when her rope entwines his jewels and cold steel of her sword touches his scepter...


[h3]Ruffie[/h3]
Age: 31

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45169059/c60732d76a598fe1b8d446585931f8346c0f2baf.jpg[/img]
Addicted to every drug imaginable, Ruffie is one of the most depraved members of the Pearl's crew. Obsessed with estrogen highs, she’s constantly trying to stay pregnant. The milk produced by her ample breasts, laced with a strong dose of the substances she consumes, is a powerful aphrodisiac and narcotic on its own. Ruffie maintains her lactation even when not pregnant, and in none of the various nearby port taverns is there a single sailor who wouldn’t do absolutely anything just to wet his lips with it.
